title: Qatar GKG attention peak fades: short LNG 3d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT Qatar GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 marks peak attention that fades: LNG log return reverses over the next 3 days (-); trade short LNG 3d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0022)
message: Not supported: Qatar GKG attention spikes do not predict LNG reversal (r=0.12, best lag -2d; short rule hit 46%, excess -0.09%, actionability 3.9). Follow-up flips to long momentum.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.qatar_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] GDELT Qatar GKG share 20d z-score > 1.5 marks attention that follows LNG strength rather than fading it: LNG log return continues positive over the next 3 days (+); trade long LNG 3d [gdelt.gkg.qatar_share -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0120)
